g.aria-label: Three Distinct Mechanisms That Can Stall a Distant Generator
JS(p, q) flattens at log 2 when supports separate (μ ≫ 1)
Does D ∈ T jump abruptly or interpolate across the gap?
Does G keep unit weight (w_ns ≈ 1) or vanish as e^D → 0?
A distant generator moves iff ∇_x D(x') ≠ 0 and the generator weight is nonzero
